title: Interior Department: Migratory Bird Hunting; 2025-26 Seasons for Certain Migratory Game Birds
summary: This rule prescribes the seasons, hours, areas, and daily bag and possession limits for hunting migratory game birds. Taking of migratory game birds is prohibited unless specifically provided for by annual regulations. This rule permits the taking of designated species during the 2025-26 season.
